name: native-edits
description: File changes through Edit and Write, not sed -i and heredocs: rewrites auto mode's shell-first advice and refuses Bash commands that write project files, so every change has a diff, can be rewound and follows the path's rules.

mode.title: Shell writes
mode.description: deny refuses a Bash command that writes a project file and tells Claude to use Edit or Write (when Claude has neither tool, the command runs); warn runs it and tells Claude afterwards; off does nothing. Nobody is ever asked.

scope.title: Which files
scope.description: project: files under the session's directory; everywhere: any local file except /tmp and $TMPDIR.

allowPaths.title: Always allowed
allowPaths.description: Comma-separated globs the shell may always write (** any depth; a glob without / matches the file name).

rewritePrompt.title: Rewrite the auto-mode note
rewritePrompt.description: Auto mode tells Claude to make file changes with sed, heredocs or short scripts, and drops the Bash tool's 'Edit files: Use Edit' lines. Rewrite that sentence and put the lines back: reading through Bash stays, changes go to Edit and Write.
